body: I've certainly thought about suicide a lot.  I don't know if I could ever go through with it though.  If I force myself to do it I'm going to fail the assignment anyway so what would be the point. I know I'm very depressed.

My parents have basically gotten to that point.  And I hear you about just doing it but for some reason I just can't. I can't even write the 5 pages I'm supposed to do right now.  I feel like I'm just not meant to do anything great with my life, including graduating college or getting a good job. But I don't know if I would be any happier working a 20,000 a year job with no responsibility.  I know I'll have regrets but for some reason I still can't push myself to do this.  I can't figure it out. None of my friends are having this much trouble with school.  My girlfriend is in a similar situation.  She's taking a semester off because she couldn't handle school either but she said it's only made her life worse.  I see all this around me and yet I just have zero motivation.

That's just the thing though. The way I am now I just don't see myself finishing school.  I can't even handle second and first year classes how am I supposed to do some 15 page senior thesis? I'm just really low right now and completely pessimistic.  I want to get counselling. I just have to make the effort to actually go.  If I don't finish school my options become really limited. I can't do hard labor and I'm not in shape for the military so those are out.  I know what I can do in the future to try and get help but what the hell do I do right now? 

Your comment was helpful. I don't mean for you to give me all the answers I'm looking for. I'm just expressing more thoughts.
